name: Belt of Giant Strength
desc: While wearing this belt, your Strength score changes to a score granted by the belt. If your Strength is already equal to or greater than the belt's score, the item has no effect on you.  Six varieties of this belt exist, corresponding with and having rarity according to the six kinds of true giants.
